description: This file is a PHP source file for a popup view in a CRM system (likely vtiger CRM). It dynamically generates popup windows for selecting records from various modules like Contacts, Accounts, Leads, etc., with support for search, filtering, sorting, and pagination. The code handles different modules by including relevant classes and rendering views accordingly.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class representing the Smarty template engine customized for vtiger CRM, used to render HTML views.

methods.name: AlphabeticalSearch
methods.description: Generates an alphabetical search filter for a module.

methods.name: getRelCheckquery
methods.description: Constructs a query fragment to check for related records.

methods.name: getPopupCheckquery
methods.description: Constructs a query fragment for checking related popups.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Builds a list query for fetching records from a module.

methods.name: fetchCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves the default currency for a user.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Gets the product name given its ID.

methods.name: getSearchListHeaderValues
methods.description: Generates header values for the list view search.

methods.name: getWhereCondition
methods.description: Builds the WHERE clause based on current filters/search.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into parts based on a delimiter.

methods.name: mkCountQuery
methods.description: Creates a COUNT query from a given SQL query.

methods.name: VT_getSimpleNavigationValues
methods.description: Returns navigation (pagination) info for list views.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Gets the tab ID for a module.

methods.name: getMailFields
methods.description: Retrieves email-related fields for a module.

methods.name: getSearchListViewHeader
methods.description: Retrieves list view headers for search results.

methods.name: getSearchListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves list view entries for search results.

methods.name: vtlib_setup_modulevars
methods.description: Initializes module variables for popup views.
